answer: Price new identities like surge fares: the join fee starts at 1 POA and doubles for every 50 joins beyond a baseline of 200 in the trailing 10 epochs (assuming normal growth near 20 per epoch), then cools like an ember as the window clears. Honest newcomers see a price steady as marble. A farm minting 500 accounts at once pays fees summing to roughly 73,300 POA, and trickling them in only keeps the fee hot for its own siblings. Fees feed the grading pool, so a wave pays for its own audit, and growth climbs slowly, like vines up a trellis.
